actions: Kept the frozen control tuple despite later note-main advancement.
Performed a bounded synthetic explicit-duration versus geometric-hazard audit on disjoint calibration/validation/held-out streams.
Measured posterior calibration, duration-shift robustness, shrinkage control, memory-admission utility, and paired bootstrap uncertainty.
Tested naive expected-utility admission and separately calibrated conservative utility-margin admission.

result: Substantive bounded result persisted. Explicit duration improves matched/moderately shifted posterior calibration but becomes harmful under duration-role reversal; a 25% geometric shrinkage reduces some brittleness. Naive utility gating is too permissive, while posterior-calibrated conservative utility margins improve decision utility under high-hazard and duration-swapped tests. The stronger hypothesis is uncertainty-aware cause inference plus duration regularization plus calibrated cost-sensitive memory admission, not hard HSMM gating.
blocker: Role-local LATEST pointer advanced concurrently after semantic freeze; safe CAS therefore refused overwrite. The immutable run delta contains the complete continuation and remains durable, but this invocation did not become the canonical LATEST pointer.
exact_next_action: Continue read-only SPLiT S1 Code.zip recovery without mutation. Replace the single fitted duration prior with a hierarchical uncertainty-aware duration ensemble (explicit-duration components plus geometric/heavy-tail fallback) whose mixture weights are updated from posterior predictive fit without event labels. Evaluate whether it detects duration-distribution shift early enough to avoid the duration-swapped failure while preserving matched calibration gains. Keep a separately calibrated cost-sensitive admission margin and compare against the prior run's unsupervised multivariate cause-likelihood baseline, fixed-hazard baseline, and shrinkage control. Then reintroduce actual PAST/GROUSE-like and Oja-like dormant-subspace trackers so utility is measured as post-silence recovery and post-switch interference rather than only a synthetic event utility proxy. Preserve disjoint calibration, held-out hazard/duration shifts, reliability/calibration metrics, admission/release precision-recall, exact tested scope, and nonempty frontier.
